title: Inventory Value before the release date counts every part as tracked
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Date {Date-A} (for example 1 October 2026) is before the Part Lifecycle build reached this environment, and the Inventory Value report has saved figures for it.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example a part whose number starts ZZAUTOTEST) is active and tracked at {Location-A} and is listed by the Inventory Value report for {Date-A} with Qty {Qty-A} (for example 4.00) and Total Cost {Cost-A} (for example $40.00).
  • {Part-A} existed before the release, so this case cannot create its own part; it puts {Part-A} back to tracked at the end.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Parts → Inventory and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open Reports → Inventory Value.
  5. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  6. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  7. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the report's Search box.
  8. Read the {Part-A} row.
  9. Change the as-of date to today and read the list.
  10. Go back to {Part-A}, click the switch so it is on, and click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: {Part-A} is listed for {Date-A} with the same Qty {Qty-A} and Total Cost {Cost-A} as before you turned tracking off: a date before release counts it as tracked.
  • Step 9: For today {Part-A} is not listed, because it is untracked today.
  • Step 10: {Part-A} shows a quantity again in the Inventory list.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), §2 Feature Overview, Accounting, and S4-R9, read 14 Oct 2026. Tech plan D6 (figures saved before release count every part as tracked). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §2 Accounting: “The Inventory Value report run for a date before release counts every part as tracked.”
  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
